text:
kate: Starting lane-slice rollout for release r1.2.0. Change window 23:00-00:00 UTC. Plan: shadow -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% every 5m. Check p95 < 1200ms, errors < 0.5%. Rollback criteria: errors > 0.8% sustained 3m OR p95 > 2000ms for 3m.
ashok: 👍 router flags ready. session affinity unchanged; kv-cache warm expected ~90s.
marco: green pool spun up (6 GPUs). warming logs show successful cache loads.
deploy-bot: initiating step: shadow traffic -> verifying health probes, warmers, and readiness checks. see: http://grafana/release/r1.2.0 :eyes:
jen: watching 5xx and latency. if we see a spike, I will post "hold" and ops will pause.
ops-bot: alert rule created: rollback-trigger if errors > 0.8% for 180s OR p95 > 2000ms for 3m. slack alert routed to #eng-oncall and #eng-releases.
kate: pinning/rollback commands in case we need to force-back to blue. paste outputs here when run.
```
curl -X POST 'https://router-api.internal/pin' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN' -d '{"version":"blue","reason":"rollback r1.2.0"}'
```
Also: alternative: `./ops route pin blue --force` from infra host.
marco: perf stable at 5% after 2m. p95 340ms, errors 0.12% :tada:
ashok: proceeding to 20% in 2m. will hold if any anomaly :eyes:
deploy-bot: traffic update: green=20% at 1767123490. watchpoints: p95 and client error rate.
jen: small error bump to 0.25% during 20% ramp, still below threshold. no hold.
kate: note — for rollback manual sequence: 1) set router pin to blue, 2) drain green pool (scale to 0), 3) revert infra flags for new model. Keep logs of each step.
marco: quick warm tip — speed up warmers if needed: `./infra/warm --pool green --concurrency 6`. use with caution.
ashok: reminder: session stickiness is cookie-based, no migration required.
jen: at 50% now. p95 420ms, errors 0.18% — still green.
kate: final shift to 100% scheduled in 5m unless anyone calls hold. closing notes to include in release notes: traffic-slicing rollout, metrics thresholds, rollback runbook.
ashok: no hold. :+1:
deploy-bot: FINAL update: green=100% at 1767123760. rollout complete. tagging release r1.2.0-deployed.
kate: resolving thread. please add a one-line release note: "Router lane-slice rollout for r1.2.0 — successful; thresholds monitored and rollback runbook in ops doc." thanks all :rocket:
